title: Apple Sandwich
description: A light, feathery sponge cake sandwiched with apple sauce — the sweetness comes entirely from the fruit with no added sugar.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan. Grease and line two 20cm round cake tins.
Sift the flour. Separate the eggs into two large bowls. Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks.
Beat the egg yolks with a wooden spoon and add 150g of the apple sauce. Beat for at least 2 minutes until pale yellow.
Fold in the flour carefully with a metal spoon, followed by the egg whites. Split between the two tins.
Bake for approximately 15 minutes, until pale golden on top. Remove and cool slightly, then turn out on to a rack.
When cold, sandwich the cakes together with the remaining apple sauce.
